title: Lentil Shepherd's Pie
subtitle: Hearty vegetarian shepherd's pie with Puy lentils
excerpt: Puy lentils and root vegetables in a rich tomato and thyme sauce, topped with creamy mashed potato and baked until golden. A satisfying vegetarian alternative to the classic.

recipe.sourceNotes: This is a vegetarian adaptation of shepherd's pie in which Puy lentils replace the lamb mince. Puy lentils are particularly suited to the role because they hold their shape during cooking rather than breaking down completely, giving the filling a satisfying texture. The sauce is built in the same way as the traditional version: a base of onion, carrot, and celery, cooked with tomato puree and stock, seasoned with Worcestershire sauce and thyme. The mashed potato topping uses olive oil rather than butter and plant milk if made fully vegan, though dairy versions are equally good. The filling can be made a day ahead.

content.text: Puy lentils do not need soaking but should be checked for any small stones or debris before cooking. They will absorb a lot of liquid as they cook, so check the filling during cooking and add more stock if it becomes dry. The filling should be well-seasoned and fairly thick before the mash goes on top.

Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pan. Fry the onion, carrot, and celery for 10 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes. Add the tomato puree and cook for 1 minute.

Add the lentils, tinned tomatoes, stock, Worcestershire sauce, thyme, and bay leaves. Season with 1 teaspoon of salt. Simmer for 35 to 40 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce has thickened. Remove the thyme and bay. Taste for seasoning.
While the filling simmers, cook the potatoes in salted boiling water until tender. Drain thoroughly. Mash with 4 tablespoons of olive oil and the remaining salt until smooth.

Heat the oven to 200 C / fan 180 C / gas 6. Spoon the filling into a large oven-proof dish. Spread the mash over the top, roughing it with a fork. Bake for 25 minutes until the top is golden and the filling is bubbling at the edges.
